mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebus_user (id, username, email, password_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM ebus_user WHERE username = #{account} OR email = #{account} LIMIT 1
